name: Jeeter XL Quad Infused Preroll | Prickly Pear
description: Prickly Pear bursts forth with the sweet symphony of flavors of cactus, pear, and apricot flavors – creating a fruity fiesta. Like an earthy encore after a desert rain, the aroma adds a ‘pear-fectly' charming twist. The Prickly Pear high is a slow dance with euphoria and creativity – promising a sociable soirée for your senses.
